# Inert selection fixtures and closed accounting

`inputs/` contains saved candidate packets. `outputs/` contains baseline and provider
results, diagnostics, validated emissions, HTML reviews, screenshots and accounting.
All original files were moved byte-for-byte. One publication exception is now labelled:
`outputs/hard-v1/q02-atomic-branches.jev-attempt1.failure.txt` has local paths replaced
with placeholders; its byte-exact original is retained privately. The error and stack
line/column numbers remain unchanged. Other embedded paths describe the historical run,
not the current layout.

The closed provider ledger remains `outputs/budget.json`. Do not reset, replace,
reopen for spending, or create a substitute ledger. Accounting siblings retain their
original bytes. There is no authorization for further inference.

Use the [offline tools](../../../tools/selection/README.md) to test or view existing
results. See [research notes](../../../docs/research/selection/README.md).
Do not execute source excerpts or serve raw provider files or panel keys publicly.
